claim: Section 174 sets the quorum for a meeting of the Board at one-third of the total strength or two directors, whichever is higher.
label: PENDING_REVIEW
original_claim: Section 174 sets one-third as the fraction of total strength forming the quorum for a Board meeting.

qualifiers.effect: the quorum is the greater of one-third of total strength and two directors; neither limb states it alone

source_span: (1) The quorum for a meeting of the Board of Directors of a company hall be one-third of its total strength or two directors, whichever is higher, and the participation of the directors by video conferencing or by other audio visual means shall also be counted for the purposes of quorum under this s
transformation: restated: the original gave one-third alone as the quorum fraction; the replacement states both limbs and the selector that chooses between them, because one-third understates the quorum on a board of three

claim: Section 174 sets the quorum for a meeting of the Board at two directors or one-third of the total strength, whichever is higher.
label: PENDING_REVIEW

qualifiers.effect: the quorum is the greater of one-third of total strength and two directors; neither limb states it alone
